_comment: Reference sheets. Render with comic_render.py --queue out/sheets.json.

jobs.prompt: a clean reference sheet on white paper. Style: comic panel, razor-sharp confident brush-and-ink line, pristine architectural perspective, crisp silhouettes, clean expressive character geometry, generous negative space. an environment sheet of a long gray Pacific Northwest beach below a bluff: a steep gravel path down, kelp on wet sand, sandpipers, a dark spruce grove at the beach's edge with light breaking through, a massive bleached drift cedar log, the surf a white line; inset: the same beach at night for a fish-run festival with lanterns, buckets and silver fish at the surf line; labeled THE BEACH. Neat hand-lettered labels are allowed on this sheet.
jobs.negative: photorealistic, 3D render, airbrush, neon, anime, watermark, extra fingers
